name: launch-github-project
description: Prepare any project for a safe, evidence-based GitHub launch.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and prepare any project for GitHub.
interface.longDescription: Classifies the project, writes the right README and release surface, checks public risk, packages a deterministic bundle, and designs goal-driven distribution without silently publishing anything.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $launch-github-project to audit this project, prepare only the release materials it needs, and ask me grouped questions only when a decision changes the output. Do not publish remotely without my explicit approval.
